mending.descripcion: Converts the experience you pick up into durability for the gear you are wearing or holding. As long as you keep earning experience, your equipment never wears out.
mending.notas: It conflicts with Infinity, so on a bow you must choose between never spending arrows and never spending the bow.

sharpness.descripcion: Increases damage against any target. It is the default choice on swords and axes.
sharpness.notas: Cannot coexist with Smite. Sharpness is better in general; Smite only wins against undead.
